hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*(--force|-f)'; then printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Force push blocked — remove --force/-f, or run manually to confirm."}'; exit 2; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; cwd=$(pwd); if echo "$cwd" | grep -qi 'health-check'; then if [ -f scripts/generate_dashboard.py ]; then python3 scripts/generate_dashboard.py 2>/dev/null && open reviews/health_dashboard.png 2>/dev/null && echo '{"systemMessage": "Dashboard regenerated and opened for review."}'; fi; fi; }
echo '{"systemMessage": "Session ending — did you log insights to insight.md?"}'

statusLine.command: bash -c 'plugin_dir=$(ls -d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/claude-hud/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '"'"'{ print $(NF-1) "\t" $0 }'"'"' | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n -k4,4n | tail -1 | cut -f2-); exec "/Users/kuoli-hung/.bun/bin/bun" "${plugin_dir}src/index.ts"'
